I'm currently working as a research engineer at Galois, Inc. I hold a bachelor's degree in mathematics from Reed College. My undergraduate spanned spectral graph theory, discrete geometry, and inference. At Galois, I have worked on probabilistic filtering and anomaly detection for dynamical systems (e.g., UAV navigation under GPS spoofing), AI-assisted formal verification, and formal verification benchmarking.
